meta.name: biznomad-shopify-cro-audit
meta.description: Full-site CRO + UX + messaging + functionality audit for any Shopify or Shopify Plus store. Runs PostHog signal, static Admin-API audits, a live browser walkthrough, CRO scoring and opus synthesis, produces a prioritized P1/P2/P3 punch list, auto-fixes P1 (revenue/compliance/data correctness) issues with backups + rollback commands, then generates a NotebookLM media pack (infographic + video overview + audio overview) for the owner. Use when the user asks to "audit the site", "audit the store", "find conversion blockers", "CRO audit", "full Shopify audit", "site inconsistencies", "messaging audit", or names a specific Shopify store + asks for any health check. Reusable across Shopify stores with per-client configuration.
